{{Quote|Oh. Yes. Yes, I understand. Ensign Caln, tractors on the two endmost raiders—lock up, and reel in.''"<br />"''Tractors engaged, ''[&hellip;]'' Attackers locked and coming toward|Captain Drusan, to Ensign Caln|<ref name="COC" />}}
[[Ensign/Legends|Ensign]] '''Caln''' was an individual who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Navy/Legends|navy]] as a [[tractor officer]] aboard the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Chimaera/Legends|''Chimaera'']]<ref name="COC" /> in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Choices of One]]'' to [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]].</ref> When [[Imperial Court/Legends|Imperial Court]] member [[Nuso Esva|Lord Odo's]] [[Kazellis-class light freighter|''Kazellis''-class light freighter]] ''[[Salaban's Hope]]'' was [[Skirmish between Nuso Esva's forces and the Chimaera|attacked]] by several [[Starship/Legends|ships]], the ''Chimaera''{{'s}} [[Commanding officer/Legends|commander]], [[Captain]] [[Drusan]], ordered the ensign to activate the [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beams]] and attract the two farthest attackers as Odo suggested. Caln complied, allowing the ''Salaban's Hope'' to destroy them before the larger [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] defeated the rest. The [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] was then brought aboard the ''Chimaera''.<ref name="COC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Caln appeared in the [[2011]] novel ''[[Choices of One]]'' written by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="COC" />
